description: Section headings the reader shows above a paragraph, keyed by the record that opens it. They are editorial aids, not translation: they are not in the source, they are written from Open Word Bible's own wording, and they may use reader settings. Every heading is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1PE.1.3.s1.en: Born again into a living hope
1PE.1.3.s1.sw: Kuzaliwa upya katika tumaini lililo hai

1PE.2.4.s1.en: The living stone and God's own people
1PE.2.4.s1.sw: Jiwe lililo hai na watu wa Mungu mwenyewe

1PE.2.11.s1.en: Good lives among those who do not know God
1PE.2.11.s1.sw: Maisha mema kati ya wasiomjua Mungu

1PE.2.18.s1.en: Suffering unjustly in the steps of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}
1PE.2.18.s1.sw: Kuteswa bila haki katika nyayo za {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}
1PE.2.18.s1.am: {{christos:የክርስቶስን|የመሲሑን}} ፈለግ ተከትሎ ያለ አግባብ መከራ መቀበል
